title: What’s the Fastest Way to Get Claim Payments Into a Customer’s Hands?
summary: Learn how claim payments can move faster with RTP, ACH, Push-to-Card, prepaid cards, virtual cards, and checks.
body_markdown:
For insurance carriers, third-party administrators, healthcare organizations, and claims processors, speed matters. When a claim is approved, customers don’t want to wait days or weeks for funds. They expect fast, convenient access to their money.


The challenge is that every customer prefers to receive payments differently. Some want money deposited directly into their bank account. Others want it instantly on a debit card. Some still require a paper check. Managing all these payment methods through multiple vendors can create complexity, higher costs, and a frustrating customer experience.


The fastest way to get claim payments into customers’ hands is to offer multiple payment rails through a single platform, allowing recipients to choose the payment method that works best for them. Check out the


[top payment platforms 2026](https://usio.com/top-10-payment-disbursement-platforms-2026/) .


That’s where Usio stands apart.


## Speed Depends on the Payment Rail


Not all payment methods move at the same speed. Organizations that rely on a single payment rail often create unnecessary delays.


**Real-Time Payments (RTP)**


Real-Time Payments provide one of the fastest ways to deliver claim funds. Once approved, money can move directly into an eligible bank account within seconds, 24/7/365. Best For:


- Urgent claims


- Disaster relief payments


- Medical reimbursements


- Customer satisfaction initiatives


**Push-to-Card**


Push-to-Card enables funds to be sent directly to eligible debit cards, often within minutes.


**Benefits:**


- No bank account information required


- Immediate access to funds


- Familiar customer experience


For many insurance and claims organizations, Push-to-Card has become one of the preferred alternatives to traditional checks.


**Same Day ACH**


When real-time delivery isn’t required, Same Day ACH provides fast, cost-effective payment delivery, usually within the same business day. Ideal For:


- Insurance payouts


- Settlement payments


- Healthcare reimbursements


- High-volume claims


**Standard ACH**


[ACH](https://usio.com/ach-payments/) remains one of the most widely used payment methods because it combines affordability with reliability. Benefits:


- Low transaction costs


- Secure electronic delivery


- Scalable for large payment volumes


**Virtual Cards**


Virtual cards provide another fast digital payment option that allows recipients or suppliers to receive funds electronically while maintaining security controls.


**Prepaid and Reloadable Cards**


Not every claimant has easy access to a traditional bank account. Usio enables organizations to distribute funds through


[prepaid cards](https://usio.com/prepaid-card-issuing-vs-traditional-payout-methods/) that can be used immediately for purchases, ATM withdrawals, or cash access. This is particularly valuable for:


- Government programs


- Benefit disbursements


- Insurance payouts


- Disaster relief efforts


**Checks and Print-Mail Payments**


Despite the growth of digital payments, checks remain important for many recipients.


The problem isn’t the payment method itself. The problem is managing separate vendors for payment processing and mailing.


Usio combines payment technology with


[print-and-mail services](https://usio.com/check-printing-and-mailing/) , allowing organizations to issue and deliver checks from a single platform.


## Why One Payment Rail Isn’t Enough


Many organizations still force recipients into a single payment method.


The result?


- Delayed payments


- Higher call center volume


- Lower customer satisfaction


- More exceptions and manual processing


Modern claim payment programs should give recipients options. A customer who wants RTP should receive RTP. A customer who prefers a debit card should receive Push-to-Card. A customer who requires a check should receive a professionally printed and mailed check.


The key is letting customers choose while the organization manages everything through a single provider.

Usio helps organizations collect money

## The Future of Claims Payments


The question is no longer whether claim payments can be delivered faster. The question is whether organizations are using the right payment mix to meet customer expectations. Customers want choice. They want speed. They want convenience.


The organizations that deliver all three will gain a competitive advantage.


By offering every major payment rail through a single platform, Usio helps insurers, healthcare organizations, government agencies, and enterprises deliver funds faster while simplifying operations behind the scenes.


## Final Thought


The fastest way to get claim payments into a customer’s hands isn’t choosing one payment method. It’s providing every payment method. With Real-Time Payments, ACH, Push-to-Card, virtual cards, prepaid cards, and integrated print-and-mail solutions, Usio gives organizations the flexibility to deliver funds how customers want to receive them, while powering both sides of the payment equation:
